James Merrick: hymns in Tonic Solfa

James Merrick (1720–1769) · Hymn writer

7 hymns on NoteFusion credit James Merrick. Each is written out in Tonic Solfa under the words, with staff notation, a piano to sing along with and a free PDF to print.

Words

  • Author of Good, to Thee We Turn

    Author of good, to thee we turn:

    Doh is F4/4Tune: YORKSolfa PDF

  • Author of Good, We Rest on Thee

    Author of good, we rest on Thee;

    Doh is D4/4Tune: CAITHNESSSolfa PDF

  • Blest Instructor! from Thy Ways

    Blest Instructor! from thy ways

    Doh is G4/4Tune: PLEYEL'S HYMNSolfa PDF

  • Teach Me, O Teach Me, Lord! Thy Way

    Teach me, O teach me, Lord! thy way;

    Doh is Eb4/4Tune: MELCOMBESolfa PDF

  • The Joyful Morn, My God, Is Come

    The joyful morn, my God, is come,

    Doh is Eb3/2Tune: MERIBAHSolfa PDF

  • While Here as Wandering Sheep We Stray

    While here as wandering sheep we stray,

    Doh is C4/4Tune: MELITASolfa PDF

  • Who Shall Towards Thy Chosen Seat

    Who shall towards thy chosen seat

    Doh is D4/4Tune: RATISBON (WERNER)Solfa PDF
